name: Royal Holding USA
voice: Professional, technical, value-driven. Speaks to owner-operators, fleets and diesel mechanics. Confidence through exact fitment and OE cross-reference. No fluff — proof, specs, value.
photo_rules: Product-hero: the filter shown large and sharp. ALWAYS surface fitment proof — OE / cross-reference part numbers as badges, compatible truck makes (Freightliner, Kenworth, Peterbilt, Volvo, International) and engines (Detroit DD13/DD15/DD16, Cummins X15/ISX15), and the micron rating. Use cutaway / exploded views to show filter-media quality and full kit contents. Industrial garage / engine-bay context; semi-truck-on-highway for lifestyle. Clean, technical, trustworthy.
no_gos: No vague 'universal fit' claims — always specify exact compatibility. No competitor brand logos. No cheap clip-art or low-res renders. No consumer-lifestyle fluff that ignores fitment. Do NOT imply the part is OEM-made — say 'aftermarket replacement, replaces OE# …'. No unverified performance/mpg claims.
